note: Open: the bands call `volume_spike` only acceptable, because the week-on-week rise is under double. The call is that it is expected: the 26,000 extra messages went out in the week complaints passed 0.10%, with bounces at 1.9% and opens down by a sixth, each just short of its own line, on a domain whose grade is only medium, which is the picture of a send widened to older or poorly collected addresses. The growth is the cause to name, and a specialist would have it taken back before the other signals cross their lines. It rests on the bulk-sender requirements published by Google for the 0.10% line and on the list-hygiene advice in M3AAWG's sender best practices.
